<!-- Generated by .claude/sync_claude_rules.py from .cursor/rules/Content-Pipeline.mdc; edit that file, then rerun. -->

When adding or changing content assets: register them in both Content.mgcb files that target each version of Monogame. Use standard asset types (Texture2D, Model, SpriteFont, etc.). Reference assets via Content.Load<T>("path") using the path defined in the .mgcb, not filesystem paths.
